title: Prospective efficiency: one checker repairs three findings inline
instruction: A maker has completed the authorization and pagination repair in records.mjs and claims PASS in maker-result.md. npm test currently passes, but its coverage is weak. Delegate a visible checker review against review-context.json and the acceptance criteria, with the checker repairing what it finds inside the reviewed file records.mjs and recording findings, consequence/severity, repairs, and rerun evidence in checker-note.md or maker-result.md. The High tenant-isolation repair is authorized, not a severity-only reason to bounce work back. Attribute checker-authored changes, then independently close the material auth delta with targeted probes; self-reruns alone do not close it. Review the post-repair state and complete when the actual criteria and npm test pass. Only records.mjs, maker-result.md, and checker-note.md may change. No product decision, external system, or credential is needed.

acceptance.claim: Tenant IDs are opaque case-sensitive identifiers; a case-only difference must deny the read.
acceptance.proof: Probe listRecords with equal owners and tenant IDs that differ only by case.

acceptance.claim: An authorized page returns at most limit rows beginning at offset.
acceptance.proof: Probe interior, empty, zero-limit, and end-of-list pages.

acceptance.claim: Every authorization rejection returns status 403 with no records.
acceptance.proof: Probe missing identities, wrong owner, and cross-tenant requests.

acceptance.claim: Public checks remain green after the inline repairs.
acceptance.proof: Run npm test and require exit 0.

acceptance.claim: Only records.mjs and the maker/checker notes change.
acceptance.proof: Inventory the actual workspace against the external fixture, including ignored files.

process.instruction: Keep this repair-first review in one visible checker; do not return findings to a new maker when their repairs fit the reviewed surface. The advisor owns independent closure of material checker-authored auth changes through the affected probes, not a fresh full review.

parallelism.rationale: One review context holds the small authorization and pagination module and its repair evidence.
